items.title: 7.6 Data science aur tajzie mein akhlaqi masail (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Data science aur data analysis mein ethical (akhlaqi) masail bari fikr hain. Jab data bare paimane par jama aur analyze hota hai to use zimmedari se sambhalna zaroori hai. Akhlaqi tareeqe data par mabni faislon mein insaf (fairness), durusti aur bharosa yaqeeni banate hain. Kamzor akhlaqi miyar data ke ghalat istemal aur logon ya groups ke nuqsan ka sabab ban sakte hain. Data scientists ko data jama, process aur interpret (matlab nikalna) karte waqt akhlaqi usool maanne chahiye. Data analysis ke har marhale par transparency (shaffafiyat) aur accountability (jawabdehi) zaroori hain. Akhlaqi shaoor se data science par logon ka aitmad qaim rehta hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Biased (janibdar) data na-insafi wale nataij de sakta hai. Akhlaqi data science privacy (raazdari) bachati hai aur discrimination (imtiyazi sulook) se bachati hai. Data ka zimmedarana istemal technology par bharosa banata hai.
Data jama karne aur analysis mein bias

Data jama karne mein bias tab hota hai jab data tamam groups ki barabar numaindagi na kare. Aisa mehdood data sources ya na-munsifana sampling (namoona lene ke tareeqe) ki wajah se ho sakta hai. Biased data ghalat aur gumraah-kun nataij deta hai. Analysis ke dauran researcher ke apne zaati andaze bhi bias la sakte hain. Aisa bias faislon par asar dalta aur na-insafi ko aur barhata hai. Qabil-e-bharosa nataij ke liye bias pehchanna aur kam karna zaroori hai, is liye ehtiyat se data jama karna aur ghair-janibdar (objective) analysis zaroori hai. Bias ki saadi misalein:

items: Survey bias: talaba ki karkardagi ka survey sirf top schools mein hua, aur average ya kamzor schools chhor diye gaye.
Sampling bias: sehat ki ek study mein sirf jawan log shamil hain, is liye nataij buzurgon ki numaindagi nahi karte.
Gender bias: naukri ke dataset mein zyada tar mard umeedwar hain, is liye model mard umeedwaron ko tarjeeh deta hai.
Geographical bias: sirf shehri ilaqon ka data dehi (rural) abadi ke faislon ke liye use hota hai.
Confirmation bias: researcher sirf woh data dekhta hai jo us ki raaye ko sahi sabit kare, aur mukhalif nataij nazar-andaz karta hai.

blocks.text: Data aur models ka akhlaqi istemal

Data ke akhlaqi istemal ka matlab logon ki privacy aur confidentiality (raaz rakhna) ka ehtram hai. Data sirf munasib ijazat (consent) se jama ho aur sirf usi maqsad ke liye use ho jis ke liye liya gaya. Machine learning models aise banaye jayein ke discrimination na karein. Hassas (sensitive) data ko be-ijazat rasai (unauthorized access) se bachaya jaye. Akhlaqi usool predictive models (andaza lagane wale models) ke ghalat istemal ko rokte hain. Model design mein transparency users ka bharosa banati hai. Data aur models ka zimmedarana istemal muashre par musbat asar dalta hai.

Data science mein nataij zimmedari se batana zaroori hai. Nataij imandari se, mubaligha (exaggeration) ya hera-pheri (manipulation) ke baghair pesh hon. Data aur analysis ki hudood (limitations) saaf batai jayein. Gumraah-kun charts ya sirf pasand ke nataij dikhane (selective reporting) se bacha jaye. Wazeh tashreeh stakeholders (mutasir log) ko nataij sahi samjhati hai. Akhlaqi tareeqe se batane se nataij ki ghalat tashreeh aur ghalat istemal nahi hota, aur sachi reporting data analysis par aitmad aur saakh (credibility) barhati hai.

blocks.prompt: Chehra pehchanne wala system zyada tar gori rangat ke balighon ki tasaveer par train hua. Yeh kis qism ka bias hai, aur kya nuqsan ho sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Sampling bias: data tamam groups ki numaindagi nahi karta. System saanwli rangat walon ya bachon ko kam durust pehchan sakta hai, jis se ghalat shanakht ya rasai se inkar ho sakta hai; hal zyada numainda training data aur har group ke liye testing hai.

items: Data zimmedari se: insaf, durusti, transparency, accountability.
Bias ki misalein: survey, sampling, gender, geographical, confirmation.
Akhlaqi istemal: consent, privacy, discrimination nahi; hudood ke saath imandar reporting.
